CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid plugins maintained by sydlexius. Watch-Aware Preloader warms the Linux page cache with the media each household user is most likely to play next, read from the media server's own watch state (resume points, next-up episodes, and recently-added), so playback starts instantly instead of waiting several seconds for an array disk to spin up. Emby is supported today; Jellyfin support is on the roadmap. Support is available via the project's GitHub Issues page.
